name: appleii-agent
description: MCP server for the Apple //e browser emulator — control the emulator and integrate with AI agents
long_description: This MCP server bridges AI agents like Claude with the Apple //e browser emulator. Through natural language, agents can manage windows, load disk images, write BASIC programs, assemble code, control the emulator, and inspect state.

tools.name: server_control
tools.description: Start, stop, restart, or check server status

tools.name: shutdown_remote_server
tools.description: Shutdown another MCP server instance on the same port

tools.name: disconnect_clients
tools.description: Gracefully disconnect all connected emulator clients

tools.name: emma_command
tools.description: Generic command wrapper — routes to all frontend tools

tools.name: showWindow
tools.description: Show and bring a window to front

tools.name: load_smartport_image
tools.description: Load a SmartPort hard drive image (.hdv, .po, .2mg)

tools.name: save_basic_file
tools.description: Save a BASIC program to a .bas file

tools.name: save_asm_file
tools.description: Save assembly source to a .s or .asm file

tools.name: save_disk_file
tools.description: Save binary disk data to a file
